variants.name: Алый капюшон
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE new ROGUE character design for this pixel-art game. Image 1 (warrior 11) is a STRICT COMPOSITION, TILE, SCALE and PIXEL STYLE TEMPLATE. Replace only that warrior with a rogue, keep the tile footprint, tile size, tile stone pattern, backdrop, camera, framing, pixel density and foot-contact location unchanged. The rogue must fit INSIDE the same head-to-boot bounding height as the warrior being replaced. Do not enlarge the character, do not shrink the tile. In a 1254-square image the character should be approximately 440 pixels high and the tile approximately 1000 pixels wide, head top about y=205 and boots around y=640. This is a SMALL compact sprite on a LARGE tile, visible floor around feet. Image 2 gives the identity and costume family: the RIGHTMOST charcoal-hooded rogue with burgundy scarf, brown leather and TWO short steel daggers. Do NOT copy the tall large rogue proportions from image 2. Match warrior 11's squat body, oversized readable head, very short torso and legs, broad compact silhouette, big boots, about 2.6-2.8 heads tall. Character is a FLAT 2D sprite viewed at EYE LEVEL, frontal three-quarter facing screen RIGHT; never a steep overhead view. Floor alone stays isometric. Clean connected pixel clusters, crisp pixel steps, limited colors, 3-4 tones per material, no grain, no painterly brushwork, no smooth 3D gradients. Bright readable warm peach face under hood, simple black eye without white or glint. Dark charcoal/blue-grey cloth with readable lighter planes, muted burgundy scarf, warm brown leather, light steel blades. Exactly two short daggers, one in each hand, both readable, no long swords, shields, plate armor, bows, magic, extra limbs or extra characters. Full character and full tile visible. Dark navy background. No text, labels, borders, HUD or collage. Single compact game miniature. DESIGN VARIANT: Closest to the reference rogue. Rounded low charcoal hood framing a visible face, short red scarf with one small tail behind, simple belted split tunic. Relaxed but alert wide stance, both daggers low near thighs angled outward. Hands stay close to compact body. Broad very short torso, short legs.
